rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Define Behavior for Ambiguous Node Structures
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket requires input from the human staff to define the desired behavior of the system when encountering ambiguous node structures in the Draw.io XML. The current parser assumes a specific structure for individual nodes (a parent cell with an identifier and a child cell with a RiC-O class).
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Context:** The parser needs to know how to handle nodes that do not conform to the expected structure. This decision will affect the robustness and flexibility of the parser.
**Question:** How should the system handle nodes that do not follow this structure?
**Options:** a) Ignore the node and log a warning. b) Raise an error and stop the parsing process. c) Attempt to infer the structure based on a set of predefined rules.
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Await Human Input:** - The agent assigned to this ticket will await input from the human staff on the desired behavior. 2. **Implement Chosen Behavior:** - Once the human staff has provided their decision, the agent will implement the chosen behavior in the `DrawIOParser` class.
